summary: Respect the microflora. A scientifically calibrated, fragrance-free gel designed exclusively for the delicate biological ecosystem of intimate areas.
description: Precision pH engineering. The vaginal flora requires strict acidity (pH 3.8 - 4.5) to remain healthy. This wash uses lactic acid to perfectly match that biological baseline, preventing irritation and infection.
technical_overview: Offered at $16.0 for 200ml, this KoColor INTIMATE_HYGIENE is expertly formulated with Water, Lactic Acid, Aloe Barbadensis, and mild Glucosides. It delivers a high-fidelity Pure Clear color profile (`#F5FFFA`) and leverages lactic acid buffering.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Lather a small amount externally during a shower. Rinse thoroughly.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Never use internally; the vagina is self-cleaning, and this product is engineered strictly for external vulvar architecture.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Absolutely zero synthetic fragrances or harsh sulfates, eliminating the primary culprits of intimate contact dermatitis.
